The apostrophe placement bothers me, though I do kind of like the idea that there is one person named “Little Picasso” and they opened up a daycare.
In my defense, he was advertising Jell-O products long before the pudding pops came on the market!
Interesting.  I would have thought Jell-O Pudding would be the Pop.
One must imagine Pissyphus crappy.
That is an amazing find! The figures look to be in pretty good shape. Are they?

Hey, when Episode III came out and they were doing this tie-in, did they have commercials where Yoda said “do the Dew or do not do the Dew, there is no try the Dew”?

If not, they really missed a trick.
“You know April 20 was actually Hitler’s birthday, which is why the Columbine shooters chose that date.” — How to Get Kicked out of the Blunt Rotation.

VERY COOL PERSON: It's four-twenty, you know what that means?

ME: Hell yeah! [starts shoving blackbirds into a pie]
Very glad I didn’t tag PFT in this skeet from December.
If you take the mask off a monster truck you'll see that it's just a regular old truck that wanted to take over an amusement park.

Watching an episode of High Potential and two characters just pronounced the work “consortium” as “con-SORT-ee-um” … it’s supposed to be “con-SORCH-um, right? Do some people pronounce it with four syllables? Really?
You’re a Good Man, John Goodman

It’s just now occurring to me that it’s kind of interesting that Matt Murdock’s best friend is named Foggy, considering that fog is something that a blind person could have little to no experience of.

Very minor spoiler for Daredevil:

Interesting to learn that Franklin Nelson already had the moderately insulting nickname “Foggy” as a youth, but apparently some people in his neighborhood didn’t think that was insulting enough so they called him “Foggy the Fembot.”

So this Darth Maul show is pretty good. I didn’t watch much Clone Wars so this cunning, sophisticated, intellectual strategist seems very different, to me, from the animalistic kill-monger I saw in Phantom Menace. Has the transition been organic or this a “no he just SEEMED like that in EP1!” thing?
Connections was feeling a little randy on Thursday.
I guess I always assumed it was every guy, not necessarily just the unattached ones. I mean… I assume it’s still hyperbole…
Sir, you’re an inspiration… In the sense that your joke inspired me to make this dumb joke.

Quick impression. Admiral Ackbar playing the troll in The Three Billy Goats Gruff when he hears a goat crossing his bridge: 

“IT’S A TRIP-TRAP!”
Is China's soft power really rising, or is America's just crumbling?
No, America is not in a "stealth manufacturing boom"
Updated thoughts on industrial policy. Economic consensus is changing, but it has a long way to go.
Hasan Piker is bad for the Democrats. Republicans embraced extremist ideology and it backfired on them. Democrats shouldn't follow suit.
You are what you consume. Personal identity should come from the things we get to choose for ourselves.
What if a few AI companies end up with all the money and power?. Contemplating the grim future of the "Robot Lords".
Will Americans want more housing if it looks prettier?
Yes, assimilation is good. Building a unified American culture isn't about bullying people; it's about living together in peace.
I told you this would end badly. In retrospect, there were signs that Trump was not a good leader.
Roundup #80: All AI, all the time. Growth; Biosecurity; Cybersecurity; Pseudonymity; Quant trading; AI adoption
Salarymen, specialists, and small businesses
How Japan has changed in the last 20 years
Maybe you should have bought an electric car. The Iran War is illustrating the cost of anti-EV nonsense.
Plentiful, high-paying jobs in the age of AI
AI has the worst sales pitch I've ever seen. "Our product will make you economically useless, and possibly kill you" is not a value proposition.
